payload.title: Rust app authoring model: schema export + init/scaffold redesign
payload.description: The cutover changed what a Frick app is: the backend is now the Rust frick-server (binary or embedded), not an embedded TS server. Define the authoring loop end to end: a schema.ts -> schema.json export (e.g. `frick schema export`) that feeds the standalone server's FRICK_SCHEMA_PATH, and a coherent frick init/scaffold model for it. FR-260 is the immediate de-breakage; this is the full design.
